# Grounded by live API capture captures/20260610T195758Z-api_order_stop_cancel_aapl.
# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: fb50c6d6a49dc509.
# Replays the STP and STP LMT rest/cancel lifecycles (ORD-001 stop variants)
# observed on 2026-06-10 against live paper Gateway. Both far-above-market
# stops (delayed-quote anchor 292.12 x 10) reached PreSubmitted with
# why_held=trigger; for the plain STP the Gateway's open_order echo reported a
# computed limit price 2921.23 next to the 2921.2 stop. Each API cancel
# produced order_status Cancelled plus the code-202 notice, and the driver's
# final safety global cancel drew real code-161 replies for both
# already-cancelled orders (339 first, then 338). In replay both 161s land
# inside the terminal drain windows, so both handles close with the code-161
# error.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to the DU9000001 redaction token,
# perm ids -> 900338/900339 (including inside the code-161 message texts),
# order refs -> ibkrgo-sanitized-20260610T195758Z-001/-002. Trimmed:
# farm-status 2104/2107/2158, the driver's startup safety global cancel and
# its code-161 reply for the previous scenario's order, and the driver's
# delayed-quote anchor exchange (market-data-type toggles, the req 1/2 tick
# stream, and the code-10089 entitlement notice).
